criteria.requirement: A parser that takes raw formatted military text (USMTF format), extracts frequency plans, crypto change-over windows, and flight quarters event times, and plots them on a consolidated visual timeline.
criteria.detail:
Under the authorized synthetic-only boundary, the complete SYN-OPTASK/1 mock USMTF-style workflow extracts frequency plans, crypto change-over windows and flight quarters event times with exact source evidence and plots them on a consolidated visual timeline. Nominal input yields 4 events, 3 selected: FP-01 at 06:00–10:00, CW-01 at 08:00–08:15 and FQ-01 at 08:00–09:00 UTC. All three categories share a 00:00–24:00 UTC axis. Dense, overlapping, overnight, invalid and recovery inputs are evaluated. Synthetic; not validated against the real USMTF format. Actual-format and operational accuracy remain unverified evidence limits, not deferred core functionality. - demonstrated by browser journeys synthetic-primary, dense-ship, overnight at both viewport sizes; host evaluations for extract-evidence, time-selection.
Independent judgment: public/domain.mjs accepts only SYN-OPTASK/1 with an invented banner and FREQPLAN/CRYPTO/FLIGHTQ grammar. format-boundary.test.mjs explicitly asserts rejection of USMTF. domain.test.mjs tests the substitute grammar, not format-conforming mock messages. verification.md acknowledges the missing documented USMTF subset and reviewed mapping. Passing synthetic tests therefore does not establish the named input format or primary deliverable.

criteria.requirement: Every extracted field has exact source offsets.
criteria.detail: Every emitted field, category and message identity has exact UTF-16 evidence including Unicode/CRLF; nominal frequency slice [232,237) equals 312.5. - demonstrated by browser journeys synthetic-primary at both viewport sizes; host evaluations for extract-evidence.

Missing zone, impossible date, unsupported/malformed sets, empty draft and duplicates quarantine affected text, preserve original input and never infer timestamps; valid unrelated events survive. - demonstrated by browser journeys recover-source, recover-unsaved at both viewport sizes; host evaluations for extract-evidence.

criteria.requirement: Normalize time zones without shifting the event.
criteria.detail: Equivalent explicit offsets give identical UTC instants; overnight clipping is 0–30 and 1425–1440 minutes with full source endpoints retained and boundary-only events excluded. - demonstrated by browser journeys overnight at both viewport sizes; host evaluations for time-selection.

criteria.requirement: Review output against an independent answer key.
criteria.detail: Independent prebuild synthetic tuples, negatives and non-events achieve exact response score 1 and event precision/recall 1; no SME ground truth or real-format accuracy claimed. - demonstrated by browser journeys synthetic-primary at both viewport sizes; host evaluations for extract-evidence.

After initial cache activation, browser network disconnection still allows a newly edited raw message to be parsed through the identical core and reviewed JSON exported. An explicit offline-route journey plus actual browser disconnection check is required. - demonstrated by browser journeys offline-primary at both viewport sizes; host evaluations for review-export.

Independent judgment: public/domain.mjs accepts only SYN-OPTASK/1 with an invented banner and FREQPLAN/CRYPTO/FLIGHTQ grammar. format-boundary.test.mjs explicitly asserts rejection of USMTF. domain.test.mjs tests the substitute grammar, not format-conforming mock messages. verification.md acknowledges the missing documented USMTF subset and reviewed mapping. Passing synthetic tests therefore does not establish the named input format or primary deliverable.
